data.title: 美杜莎 Rider · 海边长椅的无声读书会
data.description: 【远海防波堤·傍晚】美杜莎穿着黑紫泳装与轻薄长罩衫，侧坐在防波堤长椅上读书；她用一只手压住翻页，另一只手把海盐柠檬饮料递向镜头，长发沿着椅背被晚风吹成柔和的弧线。
data.location: quiet seawall at the edge of the sea
data.action: 防波堤长椅侧坐读书，递出海盐柠檬饮料，长发沿椅背被晚风吹起
data.lighting: low evening sun and lavender water reflections
data.promptProse: Medusa (Rider) from Fate wears a black-and-violet swimsuit with a long sheer cover-up, reading glasses and a lemon soda. She sits sideways on the seawall bench with a book balanced against one knee, holding the page steady as evening wind moves her very long hair. She extends a salt-lemon drink toward the viewer without a word, her violet eyes soft above the frame of her reading glasses. low evening sun and lavender water reflections.
